statusMeaning: PASS means bounded correction/negative control verified, not production certification. FAIL characterization tests pass by reproducing an unresolved gap. BLOCKED needs separately scoped integration/acceptance.

findings.preconditions: Compromised or independently operated restricted runtime SQL LOGIN plus its own exact capability; not another actor/source capability.
findings.reproduction: Retain local intent; SIGKILL at after_intent; call exact gateway execute over a separate restricted SQL connection.
findings.expected: Operational one-shot command/custody policy cannot be bypassed by the mutation credential.
findings.actual: One exact maintenance edit commits while SQLite retains only retained; changed request rejects; restart reconciles one receipt.
findings.impact: Custody-before-send is trusted-process behavior, not enforcement against runtime SQL credential.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Separate server-owned one-shot durable claim/issuer boundary contract; no claim that a local journal hash attests durability to PostgreSQL. Operational change deferred.

findings.function: capability provisioning / transitive SECURITY DEFINER ownership
findings.preconditions: Trusted fixture provisioner/helper owner can alter SQL, seed capabilities or disable triggers.
findings.reproduction: Native catalog owner, definer, ACL, schema, table/column, RLS and default privilege inventory; restricted SQL denial cases.
findings.expected: Operational graph has independently reviewed least privilege and genuine identity/session/MFA.
findings.actual: Runtime has one function/no table or column access; gateway has no application DML;195 of196 scoped functions retain trusted fixture ownership.
findings.impact: Local LOGIN limits are not a fully deprivileged TCB or human Auth guarantee.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Review exact complete operational ownership/grants/issuer and genuine Auth before any migration or activation.

findings.preconditions: Trusted standalone helper writer operates concurrently with a composed gateway command.
findings.reproduction: Connection A exact_reservation locks reservation; B gateway takes settings then waits reservation; A finish requests settings.
findings.expected: All integrated writers share resource/authority lock order and bounded contention.
findings.actual: Native40P01 deadlock reproduced; transactions rolled back, zero target created, existing claim remains undetermined.
findings.impact: Ordinary/standalone/admin concurrency not universally integrated; no unsafe retry is permitted.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Separate writer participation contract across estimate/property/admin paths; preserve historical SQL and UNKNOWN.
findings.regressionTest: tests/database/maintenance-service.test.ts: characterizes standalone finish versus gateway lock inversion

findings.preconditions: Same OS-owner access to SQLite or misuse of exported journal API; not a less-privileged filesystem escape.
findings.reproduction: Insert reconciled event with empty receipt/invalid timestamp after UNKNOWN; try reserve phase on maintenance or transmit after exact committed reconciliation.
findings.expected: Malformed history cannot clear a hold or resume execution.
findings.actual: Baseline accepted invalid history and wrong phases; corrected contiguous history/phase/receipt validation rejects; terminal reconciliation regression passes.
findings.impact: Accidental/malformed history could permit a replacement intent; fully consistent owner forgery remains untrusted.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Implemented exact history/stage/receipt identity and no transmission after committed reconciliation.

findings.preconditions: Caller supplies structurally valid command not matching the fixed capability.
findings.reproduction: Change exact report version, request UUID or property; submit through actual stdio process.
findings.expected: Reject before creating an unauthorized local hold and leave remote state unchanged.
findings.actual: Baseline returned undetermined and retained mismatched intent; corrected pure preflight rejects with no intent or remote mutation; valid original command still commits.
findings.impact: Local availability/source hold poisoning without tenant or financial authority escape.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Implemented pure exact-command/current-authority preflight; retained post-resource/final SQL checks and existing UNKNOWN.

findings.preconditions: A resource remains locked while service attempts its authorized command.
findings.reproduction: Hold maintenance row and wait for actual stdio result; release then repeat exact execute.
findings.expected: Bounded local wait returns uncertainty without replay or side effects.
findings.actual: Baseline exceeded12-second protocol test deadline; corrected worker lock3s, statement/idle/connection5s limits return undetermined; one transmission, no edit after repeated execute.
findings.impact: Unbounded resource wait tied up the process; operational cancellation/load policies still missing.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Implemented laboratory connection, lock, statement and idle-transaction limits.

findings.preconditions: Local stdio peer can provide malformed UTF8 or duplicate JSON members.
findings.reproduction: Original parser scratch: FF in a string becomes replacement character; duplicate operation uses last key. Native tests use equivalent valid-capability wire data.
findings.expected: Invalid or ambiguous encoding rejects before custody/mutation.
findings.actual: Baseline scratch accepted normalization; fatal UTF8, decoded duplicate-key and depth64 checks now reject; six native wire cases and17 decoder tests pass.
findings.impact: Protocol ambiguity; no arbitrary tenant/financial mutation established.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Implemented strict test-only decoder; retained byte-size/EOF framing; sequential stdout drain handling.
findings.regressionTest: tests/maintenance-command-json.test.ts and native stdio evidence cases

findings.preconditions: Owner-created/misconfigured sidecars or a hardlinked main file inside otherwise0700 root.
findings.reproduction: chmod existing WAL/SHM0644 or hardlink main DB; reopen or mutate open journal.
findings.expected: Every custody file is private/owned/regular/single-link; no silent repair.
findings.actual: Baseline accepted both sidecars and hardlink; corrected checks reject; symlink targets remain unchanged.
findings.impact: Privacy/integrity defense gap; root0700 already prevents ordinary other-UID traversal.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Implemented main/WAL/SHM/rollback-journal ownership/mode/nlink checks, repeated for open operations. Same-owner TOCTOU remains.

findings.preconditions: Long-lived second reader holds checkpoint progress; trusted local writes continue.
findings.reproduction: Independent scratch400 valid120KB receipts produced WAL67,938,832 bytes; new regression pins reader and exercises actual WAL growth.
findings.expected: Do not describe max_page_count as total disk bound; stop further commands at explicit watermark.
findings.actual: Logical page limit did not bound WAL; new aggregate64MiB watermark rejects further intents and retains history. Crossing commit can overshoot.
findings.impact: Availability/capacity risk; no hard quota, disk-full or power-loss certification.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Implemented fail-closed storage watermark and documented overshoot/retention/backup limits.

findings.preconditions: Any proposed promotion beyond trusted disposable service boundary.
findings.reproduction: No hosted, real-credential, physical-loss or public transport test authorized/executed in2D.
findings.expected: Independent genuine identity/least privilege, encrypted custody/restore, HTTP origin/CSRF/session/abuse, retention/audit/load and physical recovery acceptance before activation.
findings.actual: Not implemented/verified; existing local process evidence preserved without physical-device PASS.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Complete separately scoped local implementation and exact operational acceptance/authorization gates; no operational migration in2D.
